title: Taxonomies in Code: Query Content Items by Term | Orchard Core
description:
A taxonomy field files a content item under terms, but a template or a service often needs the opposite: the content items filed under a given term. The Taxonomies module offers three places to ask: the TaxonomyIndex table, the Lucene index, and the query that every term page runs.

This video shows what a TaxonomyField stores, how to query the TaxonomyIndex with QueryCategorizedContentItemsAsync or ISession, how to index the terms for Lucene and save a Lucene query with parameters, how to call that query from Razor and Liquid, and how a term page builds its list.

In this video:
• Where the terms are stored
• Query the TaxonomyIndex
• Index the terms for Lucene
• A Lucene query with parameters
• Call the query from code
• The term page query

links.label: Guide: query content items based on taxonomy
